name: TA-9-dsm-disabled-threshold
why: The control for TA-9's threshold: the identical flat terrain and the identical heightAboveGround layer (5 m returns at (1,2) and (2,2)), but obstacleHeightThreshold left null instead of 2. §12 is explicit that above-ground evidence blocks/penalizes only when the layer AND the threshold are both enabled; with the threshold unset, obstruction must be inactive everywhere and the route must go straight through the very cells TA-9 detours around.
